author: MarcosRGjr
text: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Cyber. Same harness: 948 working Linux priv-esc exploits (was 166 on 5.6 Sol), 81 novel high-severity Firefox bugs. Preparedness Framework: Critical.

author: baltimore465
text: OpenAI just launched GPT-6 Cyber. In testing: 81 new Firefox vulnerabilities, exploits for 948 Linux kernel flaws, a critical bug in Brotli validated. All disclosed and patched. Daybreak Red only.

author: kman62
text: OpenAI's AI agents found and exploited 948 Linux kernel root-access flaws in one run at about $1.2M API cost. Earlier run reported 200; human review cut many.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: PHP knew about PHP2Shell in 2024 with no concrete attack path so no fix. Researchers using AI found the way in within about a week. PHP Foundation calls the delay a structural failure.

author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 CVSS 9.8 remote root, no login needed. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1 million MPTCP-facing servers already being scanned. Ubuntu still shipping the patch late.

author: TechnologyAlign
text: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 abused ConnectWise Cloud Backup in a supply-chain attack, using an AI tool called Artex to automate breaches of hundreds of orgs worldwide.

author: _pksharma
text: Anthropic declined to fix ThisBash, a flaw allowing browser extensions to escape the browser sandbox and run code on local and corporate endpoints via Claude Desktop. 6-step chain from MAIN-world script injection.

author: michael_varis
text: Anthropic logged ThisBash as valid in May, closed it as a duplicate, paid no bounty, issued no CVE, and missed its own October plan to retire Dispatch. Support still says keep using it.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: New CVE with public exploit: CVE-2026-48705 (CVSS 9.3). MONAILabel Server crash and silent inference corruption via crafted DICOM (pydicom DS/IS validation bypass). Remote, no login. AI medical imaging toolkit.

author: EmunaEliran
text: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass: entire chat history exfiltrated. Check Point bypassed Lockdown Mode's prompt injection protections via the HTML preview sandboxed iframes.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes vulnerability patched! AI agents could access host files via prompt injection. Update to v0.51.0 now. CVE-2026-103916

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Attackers exploit the GPUStack authentication bypass CVE-2026-102895 in the wild. Update to 2.2.2 now to fix this flaw and CVE-2026-102894.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed a supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection silently hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: ZeroAgencyAI
text: Asked your agent for 'a GitHub MCP'? It may have picked Anthropic's archived one from memory. No fixes coming. Puppeteer's MCP server has an RCE via prompt injection.

author: baoge808
text: 98% of coding-agent sessions install archived, vulnerable MCP servers on their own (Glow Labs, MCPhantom). 17.3M npm downloads of packages with known RCE via prompt injection.

author: eric_m_freeman
text: Copilot in Edge picked the scammer 20 out of 20 times. Researchers planted one fake review and the agent ruled out the real provider.

author: dd_pwnd
text: LLMjacking: attackers grab cloud AI API keys from leaked code or phishing and run up bills; one company hit for $100,000 in a single day.

author: Netwrix
text: Slopsquatting: AI coding assistants invent package names and attackers register them, a supply chain attack.

author: UndercodeUpdate
text: Moving Beyond the Hype: Securing AI Agents Against the Lethal Trifecta and Advanced Prompt Injection.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Videostrong Technology Co., a China-based Android OEM, implanted a backdoor into devices it sold. Backdoors established XCPE botnet used for ad fraud, data theft and routing malicious traffic. Google reports ~10M compromised devices.

author: undercode_news
text: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic event invitations used in sophisticated phishing campaign targeting Microsoft and Google accounts (Kali365 / device-code and AiTM kits).

author: rst_cloud
text: Storm-2603 fileless SharePoint/ToolShell attack analyzed by Kaspersky: runtime subversion after ToolShell exploitation (Warlock).

author: JNitterauer
text: Todyl and Huntress: an automated operator is replaying stolen credentials to reach MSP Microsoft 365 and Azure tenants and their downstream clients.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Application identity abuse targets MSPs: threat actor authenticates as trusted Azure apps, bypassing MFA, to harvest credentials across multiple customer tenants, ongoing since November 1, 2026.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: NTT DOCOMO data breach: unauthorised external access affecting servers supporting DOCOMO Online Shop and My docomo.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: Binance and Deribit have revoked API keys connected to SignalPlus following a potential security issue.

author: Dave_Joe_9377
text: The PC launcher for Goddess of Victory: NIKKE is suspected of spreading malware enabling remote control (supply-chain via hijacked open-source domain).

author: EnclaveRadar
text: New CVE with public exploit: CVE-2026-123158 (CVSS 8.1) OpenSSH authentication bypass on musl libc (sshole). Remote, no login needed. Fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2.

author: SockAnalystHQ
text: Alpine OpenSSH auth bypass (CVE-2026-123158 / sshole). Key-only accounts with * in shadow unlocked with 257–1024 byte password when PAM is off and PasswordAuthentication is on. Fix: apk upgrade then restart sshd, or PasswordAuthentication no.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Unpatched OpenSSH authentication bypass on musl libc lets unauthenticated attackers log in as root using a crafted long password; affecting Alpine Linux 3.16 through edge and other musl-based systems by default.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical Windows Paint vulnerability allows remote code execution without authentication, CVE-2026-83844. Microsoft Store fix; no known in-the-wild exploitation yet.

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Attribution: DPRK/Lazarus-nexus.

author: MsftSecIntel
text: Amid conflicting reports about PHP2Shell, Microsoft Threat Intelligence Podcast covers exploit research and IR perspectives on exposure and exploitation conditions.

author: ita_ipo
text: Actively exploited: WordPress Core RCE (CVE-2026-119977), CISA deadline Nov 6. Apple pointer-auth bypass (CVE-2024-27834) also just hit the KEV list.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, watchOS: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2024-27834 added to CISA KEV.

author: SmarterMSP
text: A critical Brotli flaw is being actively exploited and could enable remote code execution across a wide range of applications and platforms.

author: cvedotnow
text: BTCPay Server: unauthenticated LND macaroon credential disclosure (CVE-2026-119757). Remote attacker without login can steal LND macaroons and take full control of the node. Patch to 2.4.2.

author: cvedotnow
text: TPC Software Matchpoint: 2 critical CVEs. Worst: static credential in mobile app grants API access (CVE-2026-111489). No patch listed yet.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-71550: CVSS 9.9 critical. SuiteCRM prior to 7.15.2 and 8.10.2: workflow controller path-traversal-capable aow_action value in require_once().

author: helpnetsecurity
text: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441).
